title: Screening and Detection of SARS-CoV-2 RNA from Buffy Coats
author: Mahesh Bachu
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wbnfame

steps.title: Collect Blood Sample from Buffy Bag
steps.instruction: Collect blood from a buffy bag within a BSL2 hood.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the buffy bag from the sealed NYBC container to a BSL2 hood.
Decontaminate the bag surface by spraying a generous amount of 70% Ethanol.
Using a 21 or 22 gauge needle fitted on a 1-5 ml syringe, carefully puncture the top of the tubing of the buffy bag to collect ~100 - 200 µl of blood.

steps.title: Initial Lysis of Erythrocytes
steps.instruction: Perform initial lysis of the blood sample to remove erythrocytes.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the blood into a 1.5 ml sterile, RNase-free microfuge tube.
Add 5 volumes of Lysis Buffer (L5) to 1 volume of fresh whole blood (e.g., 500 μl L5 to 100 μl blood).
Incubate on ice for 10 minutes.
Within the BSL2 hood, vortex the tube briefly 2-3 times during incubation until the solution turns translucent.

steps.title: Isolate Leukocyte Pellet
steps.instruction: Centrifuge and wash the sample to isolate the leukocyte pellet.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 4°C at 400 x g for 10 minutes.
Completely remove and discard the supernatant, retaining the pellet.
Resuspend the leukocyte pellet in Lysis Buffer (L5) (e.g., 200 μl L5 per 100 μl of original whole blood) and mix well by brief vortexing.
Centrifuge the tube at 4°C at 400 x g for 5 minutes.
Completely remove and discard the supernatant.
Verify the pellet is white with no red traces; if significantly red, wash the pellet with Lysis Buffer (L5).

steps.title: Prepare Leukocyte Lysate
steps.instruction: Resuspend the purified leukocyte pellet for RNA extraction.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the leukocyte pellet in 350 μl Lysis Buffer (L3).
Mix well by vortexing briefly to ensure no cell clumps remain.

steps.title: Prepare rRT-PCR Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the reaction master mix in a clean hood reagent set-up room.

substeps.instruction: Place rRT-PCR buffer, enzyme, and primer/probes on ice or a cold-block.
Mix buffer, enzyme, and primer/probes by inversion 5 times.
Centrifuge reagents and primers/probes for 5 seconds to collect contents at the bottom.
Label one 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube for each primer/probe set.
Determine the number of reactions (N): If samples (n) including controls are 1-14, N = n + 1; if 15 or greater, N = n + 2.
Calculate and add the required amount of each reagent for N reactions for each primer/probe set.

steps.title: RNA Extraction via Spin Cartridge
steps.instruction: Extract total RNA using a spin cartridge and wash buffers.

substeps.instruction: Add 350 μl 70% ethanol to the leukocyte lysate and mix well by brief vortexing.
Transfer the lysate to a Spin Cartridge in a Collection Tube.
Centrifuge the Spin Cartridge at 8,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.
Discard the flow through and place the cartridge back into the collection tube.
Add 700 μl of Wash Buffer (W4) to the Spin Cartridge.
Centrifuge at 8,000 x g for 30 seconds at room temperature.
Add 80 μl of DNase I solution to the Spin Cartridge.
Incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Final RNA Washing and Elution
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA and elute it into a clean tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μl of Wash Buffer (W4) to the Spin Cartridge (if DNase I was used, incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature).
Centrifuge at 8,000 x g for 30 seconds at room temperature and discard flow through.
Add 500 μl of Wash Buffer (W5) with ethanol.
Centrifuge at 8,000 x g for 30 seconds at room temperature; repeat this wash step once.
Discard flow through and place the cartridge into the kit's Wash Tube; centrifuge at 8,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature to remove residual W5.
Place the Spin Cartridge in a clean 1.7-ml Elution Tube.
Add 20-50 μl of sterile, RNase-free water to the center of the cartridge.
Incubate at room temperature for 1 minute.
Centrifuge at 8,000 x g for 1 minute at room temperature.
Discard the cartridge and store total RNA at -80°C or use immediately.

steps.title: Set Up rRT-PCR Plate
steps.instruction: Prepare the reaction plate and dispense master mix.

substeps.instruction: Set up reaction strip tubes or plates in a 96-well cooler rack.
Dispense 15 μL of each master mix into the appropriate wells across the row.

steps.title: Add Controls and Samples
steps.instruction: Add NTC, samples, and positive controls to the reaction plate.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 5 μL of nuclease-free water into the No Template Control (NTC) sample wells (column 1) and cap securely.
Gently vortex nucleic acid sample tubes for 5 seconds, centrifuge for 5 seconds, and place in a cold rack.
Pipette 5.0 μL of each sample into columns 2-11; change tips after each addition and cap securely.
If necessary, add 5 μL of Human Specimen Control (HSC) extracted sample to the HSC wells (column 11) and cap securely.
Pipette 5 μL of nCoVPC RNA to the sample wells of column 12 and cap securely.
Briefly centrifuge reaction tube strips for 10-15 seconds (or centrifuge 96-well plates for 30 seconds at 500 x g, 4°C) and return to cold rack.

steps.title: Run Real-Time PCR
steps.instruction: Execute the PCR run using the instrument template.

substeps.instruction: Create a Run Template based on the available real-time PCR instrument and run the machine.
